ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Execution via macOS Script Editor
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when the macOS Script Editor utility spawns an unusual child process.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\/Script\\ Editor$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\/curl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/bash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/zsh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/dash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/fish$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/osascript$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/mktemp$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/chmod$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/php$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nohup$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/openssl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/plutil$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/PlistBuddy$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/xattr$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sqlite$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/funzip$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/popen$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*python.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*perl.*"))))
